title: What is the Knowledge-to-Experience Agent Harness?
description: Short overview of the modular agent harness that turns knowledge sources into trusted short educational videos and interactive experiences.

transcript.text: Welcome to the Knowledge-to-Experience Agent Harness.
Imagine taking a GitHub repository, a research paper, or a set of documents, and turning them into clear, short educational videos.
At the center is an intelligent agent harness. It ingests knowledge sources and produces searchable videos with grounded chat.

title: CMS Policy-as-Code: From Unstructured Documents to Auditable Rules
description: How the neuro-symbolic engine converts CMS NCD/LCD policies into executable, versioned coverage rules with full Decision Traces.

transcript.text: Healthcare payers face a massive challenge: interpreting thousands of CMS National and Local Coverage Determinations.
This is why CMS Policy-as-Code exists. It uses a neuro-symbolic approach.
Then a deterministic rules engine evaluates claims at runtime, producing a full Decision Trace that is fully auditable.

title: Why Policy-as-Code Matters for Healthcare Payers
description: The business impact of reducing manual interpretation, denials, and compliance risk through auditable policy-as-code.

transcript.text: For healthcare payers, coverage decisions drive revenue and compliance risk.
Policy-as-Code changes the equation. Decision Traces show exactly which policy version and which rule produced every yes or no.

title: Neuro-Symbolic Architecture Explained
description: Deep dive into the neuro-symbolic pipeline: extraction into a versioned Context Graph followed by deterministic rules.

transcript.text: The architecture is neuro-symbolic by design.
At runtime, only deterministic rules execute. No language model is involved in the coverage decision.
The output is an immutable Decision Trace that links the claim facts, the exact graph version, the rules applied, and the final outcome.

title: How a Claim Becomes a Decision Trace
description: End-to-end walkthrough of claim evaluation against the Context Graph producing an auditable Decision Trace.

transcript.text: Here is how a claim becomes a Decision Trace.
The engine selects the relevant policy version from the Context Graph based on effective dates and jurisdiction.
The result is a clear coverage decision plus a full Decision Trace.
